description: Change of use of the existing dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to a small House in Multiple Occupation (Use Class C4) for up to 6 persons (retrospective); bin and cycle storage.
decision_conditions: <p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposal results in a lack of privacy and overlooking to bedroom 4 from the rear communal garden area, vertical stacking of the layout gives rise to amenity impacts to bedroom 2, and a lack of daylight/sunlight access and outlook to the ground floor living space, results in a detrimental impact on the amenities of current and future occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), policies D3.D(9), D3.D(10) and D14 of The London Plan (2021), policies GR1 and HO10 of the Harrow local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
